description: Neuroscience is an interdisciplinary field that explores the nervous system from molecules and cells to circuits, behavior, and social interaction. Drawing on biology, psychology, chemistry, physics, computer science, engineering, mathematics, and philosophy, this course introduces foundational concepts, methods, and tools used to study the brain. Students examine major open questions, explore how neuroscience benefits society, and learn how the components of the neuroscience major integrate into a coherent program of study. Offered annually during fall and spring semester. Open only to first year students.
name: Integ Intro to Neuroscience
notes: Students registering for NEURO 125 must also register for NEURO 125 A or B lab.
Open only to incoming first-year students.
title: Integrative Introduction to Neuroscience
